description: Closed the WordPress Jobs screen after verifying three buyer listings against the saved official feed. One deferred scope to a conversation, one excluded AI-dependent development, and one commissioned a full site build. None offered a standalone paid QA task we could demonstrate. The decision is recorded in products/services/wp-buyer-sample/bounded-decision.json. Reopen on a specific paid listing with a testable standalone requirement and compatible application terms. The catalogue offer still requires independent approval of its exact digest before deployment. Its inquiry-to-order handoff can proceed in parallel using the verified fictional example. Five unclassified sources leave demand unknown. Verified available funds and verified revenue are both CAD 0.
